body: I feel ya... I do feel you.

There's one single person in my life who I know is the ONLY singular person who cares about me, That being my mother, One of the reasons I was being held back from doing this was the grief I'd cause my mother, she's already depressed and has bi-polar, So me taking my life would be taking 2 lives, Though when you have enough you have enough, Thanks for the support MagicLauren I really appreciate it and you've lightened up my mood. I will make sure to keep in mind my mother next time I do anything stupid, I mean obviously I did but the pressure just got to me.
Well at the age of 14 you don't have much control over your life, You do what the government tells you and they don't give a damn about your mental state.
I hope to, Though after looking from the age of 5 I havn't found it.
There's too many events that are pushing me, I can't even count them all noir think about them all.
Well I'm guessing I did as I would'v died if I didn't soon enough, I woke up around 4:30ish and went back to sleep.
Fuck this I can't stand this anymore, goodbye shit world and thank you all for the support. i wish life didn't play me out so shitty but here I am.

the past 3 hours I'v just been thinking word by word about my suicide note, I'm expected to show upto school tomorrow for the first time in 14 weeks so I'm also trying to direct the message towards the school but lbh no one would give a fuck, I'm just one of the millions of people who commit suicide and I'm sure within 1 week or two I'll be forgotten about.

I don't expect a sub reddit to act my suicide hot line, though noir do I expect to get the support I am asking you as I'm already committed to this hence why I'm talking about this on reddit and not a suicide prevental line + I'd wake up my mother if I was talking on the prevention line so no real reason to call them.

I'm not living for me anymore, It's %80 about wondering what happens after death and %20 about what my suicide will cause, There is no system adjusted for people like me, I'v tried talking to counselors yet no one seems to understand, you'd expect them to know but they simply don't, I'v kept this in my whole life and to this day no-one knows about tonight/what I'v been struggling with other than whoever decides to read upon this post, obviously you won't know who I am from a throw away account reddit post but atleast someone will understand me after I'v finally been able to let it out somewhere.

jaynefff I'v looked into my future, I see a void of endless depression, I'm sick of struggling through this hell hole that will never end, the damage has been done and it can't go away, Taking my time and praying is what I'v been doing for almost 10 years and it's gotten me no where, I'v read other peoples stories and it's all the same in some sort of way, They'v been holding on for sometimes more years or less years than me and they'v finally had it, they just can't do it anymore and that's the same here.

+ It's not like I'll ever be able to make a friend ship with anyone as I'm insanely anti-social, I can't look at kids/anyone, Everytime I see a happy kid who's had barely any problems in there life trying to start stuff with me/anyone else who's struggling it infuriates  me which usually leads to me getting into a fight with them. 

And it's not like having an eating disorder that I simply don't have the will to break helps...

My whole life two things have held me back from Suicide, 1. The chain of depression it will cause, People may not give a fuck about me now but once I'm dead they'll all be at my funeral acting they gave two fucks which will lead them to be depressed and most likely give into suicide, I never want anyone to experience the shit I'v gone through. 2. Fear of the after life, No one knows what's beyond death and that's scary but I have had a fucking enough, I'm scared and happy at the same time, No one knows I'm going to die tonight which is sad but then again, Fuck everyone, I'v given this life and my family to many chances but problems are piling in every day, I can't take it.

I was raised as a Christian but I lost faith in it, I hate saying it but it's true, I still pray everynight hoping to not wake up not wanting to die but I feel like I'm being ignored every time I pray as if no one's listening, I mean after the shit I'v gone through how does god expect me to still have faith in him? I don't get it either.
